points.quote: | `common` | Any JS environment, with no DOM or Node APIs | `common` only |
| `browser` | The browser or renderer, with DOM APIs | `common`, `browser` |
| `node` | Node.js, for example the server or extension host | `common`, `node` |
| `electron-browser` | The Electron renderer (the window, with sandboxed access to Electron APIs) | `common`, `browser`, `electron-browser` |
| `electron-utility` | Electron utility processes (shared process, pty host and so on) | `common`, `node`, `electron-utility` |
